run_training: run the multi-GPU VarNet training for MRI banding removal using spawn_dist.run with the config dictionary
configure_trainer: configure the VarNetTrainer with architecture, data transform, and method string settings in the config dict
configure_adversary: configure the orientation adversary model with strength, warmup, and regularization parameters in the config dict
configure_data: configure k-space data parameters including acceleration, low frequencies, and coil count in the config dict
configure_checkpoints: configure model checkpoint restart settings with path and type in the config dict
